excerpt: Compare furnished and unfurnished Ajman apartments using total tenancy costs, flexibility, inventory and the length of your stay.
introduction:
A furnished apartment can reduce the work and initial purchases needed to move into Ajman. An unfurnished home can offer more choice over your belongings, but you may need to buy, move and later sell or store furniture. The better rental depends on the actual lease and how long you expect to stay.

Compare like-for-like homes and calculate the whole cost over your intended period. The example below shows how to compare the full rental costs over the same period.
takeaways: Compare the total cost over the intended stay, including furniture purchases, moving and a realistic resale assumption.
A furnished inventory should identify the condition and responsibility for each included item.
Check utilities, deposit, maintenance, payment and early-exit terms for both leases.

sections.heading: What does furnished mean for this apartment?
sections.body:
There is no substitute for a written list of what is included. A furnished advertisement may cover the main furniture but leave out linen, kitchen equipment or working appliances. An unfurnished apartment may still have fitted wardrobes or kitchen equipment. Ask to inspect the exact unit and record what stays.

Check the bed, sofa, dining furniture, appliances, curtains, storage and any other items you expect to use. Photograph existing wear and test the appliances before handover. Agree how a broken item is reported and who repairs or replaces it.

Compare the properties on location, size, parking, condition and lease term as well as furnishing. The [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026) is a starting point for deciding where to search, while the actual unit determines the offer.

sections.heading: Calculate a one-year comparison
sections.body:
Imagine a furnished apartment costing AED 50,000 for one year and an unfurnished alternative costing AED 42,000. Assume the furnished option has AED 1,000 in additional end-of-tenancy cleaning, while the tenant spends AED 10,000 on furniture for the unfurnished home and later sells it for AED 4,000.

Under those sample assumptions, the furnished total is AED 51,000 and the unfurnished total is AED 48,000. The example excludes deposits, utilities, agency and lease charges, and assumes all other costs are equal. None of the amounts represents a current quote, typical rent or guaranteed furniture resale value.

The chart shows the resulting totals. Change the inputs for your own homes and check whether different services or contract terms make the comparison unequal.

sections.heading: Consider the length and certainty of your stay
sections.body:
For a short or uncertain stay, avoiding furniture purchase and later removal may be valuable even if the rent is higher. Check whether the offered lease actually matches your intended dates and what you owe if you leave early. A furnished apartment is not automatically a short-term rental.

For a longer stay, spread the purchase and moving costs over the expected period and compare the recurring rent difference. Do not count the full purchase price as an annual cost in every year. Consider wear, replacement and whether your future accommodation can use the same furniture.

If the stay is uncertain, run both a one-year and longer scenario. Keep resale proceeds conservative and separate from cash needed on the day you buy the items.

sections.heading: Read the deposit and maintenance clauses
sections.body:
Request the deposit amount, return process and examples of permitted deductions in writing. A furnished inventory helps both parties distinguish pre-existing wear from later damage. Agree the inventory at the start and again when returning the keys; retain receipts and dated photographs.

Clarify whether the landlord will repair a supplied washing machine, air conditioner or other appliance and how quickly a fault should be reported. For your own furniture, check whether the agreement restricts installation, wall fixtures or moving large items through shared areas.

Ajman's [residential lease authentication service](https://ajman.ae/en/happiness-bundle/services/establish-business/authentication-lease-contract-residential-purposes) describes the Tasdeeq application. Confirm the current cost and responsible party for your lease. Do not assume furnishing changes the authentication requirement without checking the actual agreement.

sections.heading: Compare utilities and other payments
sections.body:
Ask if electricity, water, cooling and internet are included in the rent. If they are separate, obtain the provider's setup requirements, deposit and tariff category. [Etihad Water and Electricity](https://etihadwe.ae/en/About/Pages/Tariff.aspx) publishes tariff categories; confirm which applies and budget for consumption. An included utility may have a limit or fair-use condition.

Write down rent instalments, brokerage, lease charges, deposits and moving expenses for both homes. Some deposits may be returned, but the tenant still needs the cash upfront. Confirm the exact amounts and terms rather than assuming a furnished home always has a particular deposit rate.

sections.heading: Find the rent premium you can justify
sections.body:
To estimate a break-even premium, subtract the expected resale value of furniture from its purchase and moving costs, then add any other costs unique to the unfurnished option. Divide that result by the number of years you expect to stay. Compare the annual figure with the extra yearly rent and costs of the furnished apartment.

This calculation leaves out convenience and personal preference, which may matter to you. It also depends on a resale amount that is uncertain and on both leases remaining comparable. Repeat it with no furniture resale proceeds and with a shorter stay to see how sensitive the decision is.

sections.heading: Request current options
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Ajman project collection](/projects?emirate=Ajman) to explore relevant residential developments. Ask whether furnished or unfurnished units are currently available and request the exact inventory and lease rather than relying on a project photograph.

[Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your preferred area, expected stay and total budget. Compare written quotes and visit the actual apartment before committing.
